independent_review:
# Independent production review

A separate read-only reviewer found no blocking production issue. Exact original
void signature and uppercase-preserving normalization match the retained sources.
The wrapper accepts zero or 2–8 points, checks finite float range before casts,
and lets native validation check ordering after rounding. Equal and collapsed X
values remain valid. Zero retains an explicit empty curve. Borrowed names and
coordinates are copied before callbacks; native ownership leases and generation/
revision guards own callback close, selection, nested edits and caller release.
Invalid, wrong-thread, closed and wrong-type calls cannot publish a replacement.
The staged Resource moves into the active draft only after full validation.

The sole native delegate owns dirty/history/source behavior and notification
fanout. No extra notification is emitted. Full-precision native APIs and ordinary
editor call paths remain unchanged. Row 57 stays PARTIAL; no old layout, GType,
binary ABI or borrowed live-brush identity is claimed.

## Final test-source review

No blocking finding. All three test deltas are additive: four options cases,
five actual C cases and one editor case; no original assertions were removed.
Options coverage checks every generated setting/input through both routes,
notification-map parity with native set_curve, float extremes/underflow and
collapsed ordering, owned input copies, reset/history/name behavior, invalid
atomicity, and close/select/write/final-reference-drop callback reentry.
The C construction probe compares immediate and post-construction notifications
and history against a control, verifies unchanged defaults, and creates no model.
The real-stroke case checks invalid edits do not split or change pixels. A valid
write commits the prior stroke exactly once, a muted mapping produces no pixels
or undo entry, and a visible mapping paints at the same location. Cancellation
restores committed pixels; two Undo/Redo steps recover exact recorded buffers.
Selected source contents/name and history remain unchanged.
Editor case 20 checks the actual curve controls in two shared views after both
C and handle writes/resets, then verifies native Apply Point retains non-float-
exact doubles. The opt-in demo asserts a real visible graph and distinct two-
point, peaked three-point and empty-reset states. Pixel inspection is separate
runtime evidence; the independent reviewer performed source review only.

Native API and ordinary editor retain full double precision. Their existing entry points are not rerouted through the float-rounding bridge.
Visual evidence is API-driven native editor integration, not a new UI control or an ordinary-user invocation of the compatibility entry.
